scene_sentence_zh: 深邃的洞穴內滴水聲迴盪，岩壁上覆滿苔蘚，陰暗處似乎有目光凝視。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a vast untouched natural cavern interior, towering rugged limestone rock walls layered with pale mineral streaks and vivid green moss, thin waterfalls streaming down the wet rock into a still turquoise pool, tall stalactites hanging from the dark rugged ceiling and weathered stalagmites rising from the floor, a broad smooth floor of wet rounded stones across the lower foreground, cool teal and grey-blue tones with soft daylight spilling in from a distant gap high in the rock, wild unbroken wilderness underground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG natural cavern interior — layered limestone walls with vivid green moss, thin waterfalls streaming into a still turquoise pool, hanging stalactites and a distant natural arch — with a broad open wet-stone floor across the lower foreground, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_sacred_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside shrine_interior and dream_throne: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
